[Illustration: A spoon on the moon]

THE MOON SPOON

A spoon fell from the moon one night and landed in the garden. In the
morning the children found it. "It is made of silver light," said the
smallest child.

[Illustration: The children in the garden]

They kept the spoon in a jar. At night it glowed, and the whole house
slept well.



The end.
